CERTIFICATION OF REPRESENTATIVE
On April 19, 2016, Hood River County filed a unit clarification petition pursuant to OAR 115-025-
0005(2) seeking to exclude its Sergeants from the existing bargaining unit. Because no objections to
the petition were filed, the Sergeants are excluded from the bargaining unit. Therefore, it is hereby
certified that
HOOD RIVER LAW ENFORCEMENT ASSOCIATION
is the exclusive representative of the following bargaining unit for the purpose of collective
bargaining:
All law enforcement employees except those employed in a supervisory or
confidential capacity, limited or fixed term employees (less than one (1) year or
part-time employees (less than 80 hours per month).
